summary: Verified owner-approved 4 TRACE earring editions (signature/foundation/heirloom/heirloom18k) end-to-end. Backend catalog, checkout session (via in-process app_client), validate-cart, merchant-feed and full frontend journey (PDP → cart → reload → checkout → /shop) all pass. One backend gap: /api/checkout/stripe/session does NOT return 409 PRICE_MOVED for TRACE when displayed vs trusted mismatch (because is_dynamic_priced('trace') is False — weightGrams=0, hand-set USD). This is NOT a payment-security issue (server always charges the trusted amount) but deviates from the spec's displayed-cents guard expectation.

minor.issue: No PRICE_MOVED (409) when displayed_unit_amount_cents=310000 for tier=heirloom18k (trusted 320000), same for heirloom 230000 vs 240000. Root cause: PRICE_MOVED check is gated on is_dynamic_priced(product_id), which returns False for TRACE because its tiers all have weightGrams=0 (hand-set USD, no live-metal adjustment). Server still charges trusted price, so no fraud risk. If spec requires surfacing a UX-level price-movement banner for hand-set USD items too, extend detect_price_move invocation in routes/checkout.py to also run for non-dynamic items when displayed_unit_amount_cents is supplied.

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether PRICE_MOVED should also fire for TRACE (hand-set USD) when the displayed cents mismatch — currently it is silently corrected to trusted. If yes, drop the is_dynamic_priced(...) gate OR add 'always-check displayed vs trusted' branch in routes/checkout.py around lines 326-343.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/checkout.py: the PRICE_MOVED guard is restricted to is_dynamic_priced==True. For hand-set USD items (TRACE, Parabola, Parabola-Heritage) a tampered or stale client price is silently overridden by the trusted price. Consider logging a telemetry event (or returning 409) when there's a non-trivial delta regardless of dynamic-pricing, to keep UX honest.
services/catalog.detect_price_move: tolerance $50/1% is fine but there is no server-side log for the 'silently corrected' case; add structured warning for monitoring.

success_rate.backend: 92% (33 of 35 asserts pass; 2 failures are spec-vs-implementation gap, not regressions)

observed_amounts.checkout_order_summary_lines: $450 / $900 / $2,400 / $3,200 USD (no size error, no PRICE_MOVED banner)

seed_data_creation: None — tests use the in-process app_client fixture bound to a disposable _pytest_<hex> database that is dropped at session end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TRACE now has 4 purchasable editions. tier-signature/foundation/heirloom/heirloom18k testids are stable. Prices are hand-set USD (no live-metal adjustment, weightGrams=0, convert_usd_luxury=False). Because is_dynamic_priced('trace') is False, PRICE_MOVED is NOT emitted at the HTTP checkout endpoint even when displayed cents are wrong — server silently charges trusted price. Previous iterations covered Parabola / Heritage / Annie Rose, all still passing. Use `app_client` from conftest for any new HTTP tests; the autouse `_block_live_backend_http` guard will SKIP tests that attempt to POST to the live preview host.
